correctness.rationale: The frozen Nauru graph is GP(12,5) (24 vertices, 36 edges), equivalently the star-transposition Cayley graph on S4, and X=Ind(G) uses augmented oriented chain conventions. Independently generated all 35,219 independent faces with dimension counts (24,240,1304,4212,8328,10036,7176,2964,752,156,24,2). Reproduced the stated deterministic 24-vertex toggle matching with 17,607 disjoint pairs and only four critical 5-cells and one 6-cell; independently topologically sorted the entire 35,219-node, 205,680-arrow reversed-Hasse graph to exclude closed gradient paths. Exact signed integer elimination gives zero 4×1 Morse differential, hence reduced integral H5=Z⁴,H6=Z with no torsion. The Cayley isomorphism establishes 144 left S4/right S3 actions, and rooting a vertex and its three neighbors yields a 144 automorphism upper bound. Independently enumerated cycle-invariant independent face unions for all 144 action permutations and verified the 15 signed augmented Lefschetz values: rows S4 types (1⁴),(2,1²),(2²),(3,1),(4) and S3 columns (1³),(2,1),(3) are (−3,5,−3),(1,−3,1),(1,1,1),(0,2,0),(−1,−1,−1). Since H6 is a 1-dimensional character, character-table nonnegative multiplicities uniquely select signS4⊠trivialS3; subtracting Lefschetz leaves H5=(signS4⊠signS3)⊗Perm4. This specifies rational H5 only and integral H6 orientation, NOT an integral H5 lattice isomorphism. All finite space was exhausted rather than extrapolated from samples.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a canonical highly symmetric 24-vertex cubic graph, and its full automorphism group yields a natural representation on the independence complex's nontrivial homology. Determining both rational degree-five and integral top orientation characters is an exact motivic refinement beyond the known wedge-of-spheres rank statement; it tells which cycles can be invariant under each symmetry class. The 15-class finite classification is self-contained and mathematically useful without requiring a family-wide theorem.

limitations: Integral homology ranks and top 1D sign; rational 4D H5 character, not a full integral G-lattice.
Prior nonequivariant wedge equivalence and automorphism-group classification are acknowledged.
